registry.preferred_label: Hepatocellular carcinoma with portal vein tumor thrombus
registry.preferred_name: Hepatocellular carcinoma with portal vein tumor thrombus
support_spans: CTA demonstrated a liver tumor with two components: a solid portion that enhanced in the early phase and washed out in the delayed phase, and a cystic component
CTAP showed absence of the right portal vein and a perfusion defect throughout the right lobe, suggestive of portal vein tumor thrombus
contradict_spans: Tumor markers including CEA, CA19-9, α-fetoprotein, and PIVKA-II were all within normal limits
